meaning: Each field is an observation record. Eligibility to run a participant is never stored here; core.eligibility computes it right before each run from these fields, the installed version and the date. observed means the condition was seen to hold; failed means it was seen not to hold; unknown means not observed yet. spec_revision names the participant spec (core.contract: final argv and mounts) a transport, context or permission observation was made with; a record made with another revision does not allow a run (2026-09-24 review R04).
